reference_definition: Approximate image point at midpoint x between the two shoes and the lower shoe-bottom y, if those locations can be placed from the image. Jumping does not itself invalidate a visible shoe. Mark unplaceable/absent/uncertain instead of guessing hidden feet.
prediction_blinding: Viewer serves original images and manual labels only; no model IDs, keypoints, quality flags, predictions or sampling groups exposed.
primary_reporting: Uniform10 contexts only, grouped by context and near/far side. Known-warning4 examples reported separately and never pooled into representative accuracy.
evaluation: Within-side unordered point-set matching; report localization and pair arrangement error only when both reference positions and both predicted proxies exist. Report all incomplete/unplaceable/reference-missing denominators separately. No ID-continuity score, contact-time task, coordinate-error pass threshold, model fitting, outcome prediction or tactical-cause inference.
